result.label: Source-read

claims.claim: The answer must contain a general or specific denial of the material allegations the defendant controverts.
claims.quote:
(b) The answer to a complaint shall contain:
(1) The general or specific denial of the material allegations of the complaint controverted by the defendant.

claims.claim: The answer must contain a statement of any new matter constituting a defense.
claims.quote:
(b) The answer to a complaint shall contain:
(1) The general or specific denial of the material allegations of the complaint controverted by the defendant.
(2) A statement of any new matter constituting a defense.
(g) The defenses shall be separately stated,

claims.claim: The defenses must refer to the causes of action they are intended to answer in a way that intelligibly distinguishes them.
claims.quote: the several defenses shall refer to the causes of action which they are intended to answer, in a manner by which they may be intelligibly distinguished.

claims.claim: A general denial is sufficient if the complaint is subject to the specified Article 2 or is not verified, subject to the verified assigned-claim exception stated in the draft.
claims.quote: If the complaint is subject to Article 2 (commencing with Section 90) of Chapter 5.1 of Title 1 of Part 1 or is not verified, a general denial is sufficient but only puts in issue the material allegations of the complaint.

claims.claim: A general denial puts only the material allegations of the complaint in issue.
claims.quote: a general denial is sufficient but only puts in issue the material allegations of the complaint.

claims.claim: For a verified complaint outside that Article 2, the denial must be positive or according to the defendant’s information and belief.
claims.quote: If the complaint is verified, unless the complaint is subject to Article 2 (commencing with Section 90) of Chapter 5.1 of Title 1 of Part 1, the denial of the allegations shall be made positively or according to the information and belief of the defendant.

claims.claim: If the claim was assigned to a third party for collection and the complaint is verified, that denial requirement applies even under Article 2.
claims.quote: However, if the cause of action is a claim assigned to a third party for collection and the complaint is verified, the denial of the allegations shall be made positively or according to the information and belief of the defendant, even if the complaint is subject to Article 2 (commencing with Section 90) of Chapter 5.1 of Title 1 of Part 1.

claims.claim: The time limit for an action on a contract, obligation or liability founded upon a written instrument is four years, subject to the stated exception.
claims.quote:
Within four years:
(a) An action upon any contract, obligation or liability founded upon an instrument in writing, except as provided in Section 336a;
claims.note: The draft’s scope is limited to unsecured written contracts.

claims.claim: Section 337(a) expressly excepts what is provided in Section 336a.
The cited General Denial form is PLD-050, revised January 1, 2024.
claims.quote: Judicial Council form PLD-050 (General Denial), Rev. January 1, 2024

claims.claim: Item 2 of PLD-050 provides for the defendant to state facts as separate affirmative defenses to the plaintiff’s complaint.
claims.quote:
2.  DEFENDANT states the following FACTS as separate affirmative defenses to plaintiff's complaint (attach additional
pages if necessary):
claims.note: This describes the item; it does not instruct every defendant to use the form.

result.summary: The cited texts support each claim. The draft includes the verified assigned-claim exception, and the real-property sale proviso falls outside its stated scope.
